remarks: Welcome to Chesterfield, one of the area's most sought-after gated communities, where comfort, privacy, and convenience come together beautifully. Tucked in a quiet enclave on a residential street. This home delivers the perfect blend of style, space and location. This spacious multi-level end-unit townhouse offers the breathing room of a single-family home with the ease of truly carefree living. The main level is made for both entertaining and everyday enjoyment. A dramatic, light-filled living room with a cozy fireplace and custom built-ins flows naturally into the dining area, with sliding glass doors opening onto a private balcony - your ideal spot for morning coffee or a quiet evening wind-down. The custom kitchen is a genuine showstopper: rich granite countertops, top-tier stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and a charming built-in casual dining nook that makes every meal feel special. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat - unwind in the jetted tub, refresh in the separate shower, and enjoy the luxury of dual fitted walk-in closets. A large second bedroom with its own en-suite bath offers wonderful flexibility, while the upper loft is perfect as a home office or creative space. The walk-out lower level adds even more room to spread out, with a generous rec room, half bath, and a private patio.
